# sapintegrationsuite_partners (Data Source)

Lists every Partner ID (Pid) known to the tenant's Partner Directory. This is the primary brownfield discovery mechanism for Partner Directory content in this provider, since Partners has no resource of its own — see docs/guides/partner-directory.md. Follows SAP's server-driven paging to return the complete list, not just its first page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_partners" "all" {}

output "known_partner_ids" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_partners.all.pids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `runtime_location_id` (String) NOT SUPPORTED YET. Edge Integration Cell targeting has not passed its acceptance test on a tenant with an Edge Integration Cell; leave this unset until it has. If set, requests go to /location/<id>/api/v1 on the same tenant host, the service root SAP Help documents for Edge Integration Cells, and the value is the runtime location ID SAP shows in the monitoring URL after selecting the Edge Integration Cell as runtime ({"edge":{"runtimeLocationId":"myedge"}}). Use it only at your own risk.

### Read-Only

- `pids` (List of String) Every Partner ID known to the Partner Directory.
